name: Major Medical Miracle
body:
Prerequisite: Minor Medical Miracle

Benefit: You can use Minor Medical Miracle to save a character who has died within 3 minutes. However, if more than 3 rounds has passed, the DC increases to 40 and the patient, if revived, suffers negative levels or Constitution drain, as if the target of a raise dead spell.
